title: iPhone Apple Music plays sound in Safari

Record device/browser, bundle and Worker, audible outcome, and any exact failure. UI or SDK success alone does not pass.
nextAction: Wait for RF-107 to merge and for the owner to deploy it, then do the owner iPhone Safari retry on the deployed bundle and record modern-access: <word>. evidence.summary: Original board entry; historical assertion, not independently verified product behavior.
Failure and owner retry boundary; not a fresh device verification in this migration.
